name: climate_adaptation_pack
description: Neglected climate adaptation / resilience unknowns with measurable operationalizations.

questions.question: Which early-warning indicators best predict cascading infrastructure failure under compound heat–drought events?
questions.operationalization: Evaluate candidate indicators for lead-time ≥7 days and precision ≥0.6 on historical compound events across ≥2 regions with infrastructure outage labels.
questions.why_it_matters: Compound extremes drive adaptation priorities beyond mean-temperature framing.
assumptions: Historical outage labels are incomplete but usable.

questions.question: How do informal water-sharing networks change household drought resilience relative to formal utility interventions?
questions.operationalization: Estimate causal effect of informal sharing intensity on days-without-water using panel or matched designs in ≥2 drought-affected cities.
questions.why_it_matters: Adaptation policy often ignores informal institutions that dominate local resilience.
assumptions: Sharing intensity can be proxied from surveys or sensors.
